item.text: The full `-race` run of all pre-existing tests passed with no race reports after a transient harness timeout on the first run. I found one more stated-behavior question worth validating: whether `NewRaft` really finishes committed-log replay before returning, or only queues it to a still-blocked FSM.

item.text: A slow-FSM probe confirms that, even below the channel-capacity limit, `NewRaft` returns before promised committed-log replay reaches the FSM. I’ve documented that as a second consequence of the startup-ordering defect and am rerunning the complete suite with the final test set.
